title: Stars and crosses of the Tepe madrasa, Nishapur
subtitle: Tepe madrasa, Nishapur

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s W1 drawing, its corners snapped to exact values. We devised the construction: one line from K1 through E fixes P, and every line is drawn through P, S or T. The drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out. Wichmann draws white bands over the lines; the tutorial draws the lines. No photo of the bricks was checked.

credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing. He takes it from Charles K. Wilkinson, Nishapur: Pottery of the Early Islamic Period (New York, 1973), plate 1 (painted bricks of the Tepe madrasa, eleventh century), and lists a fragment of a frieze in the Metropolitan Museum of Art (39.40.67). The construction is ours.

given.O: The centre of an eight-pointed star.
given.A: Halfway from O to the next star on the horizontal line.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1, a corner of the cell. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: Draw a straight line through O and K2. It crosses the circle at E. Draw a straight line through K1 and E. Draw a straight line through A and C. It crosses the line through K1 and E at P.
Draw a vertical line through P. Draw a horizontal line through P. Turn the two lines round O by 90°, three times.

The vertical line through P crosses the line from O to K1 at G. Draw a circle with centre O through G. It crosses the horizontal line at S. Draw a line through S parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The lines make the star at O.

Draw a circle with centre A and the same radius as the circle through G. It crosses the vertical line through A at T, above A. Draw a line through T parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the star at O and the lines that carry its sides on, with the lines through T. They close the crosses, the long pieces and the small squares.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. A star sits at every centre and a small square at every corner.
